releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.38 — friends, voice and video. The Friends tab no longer shows "No friends yet" when the request itself failed: it retries three times, reloads the list whenever the realtime connection comes back, and prints the reason with a Retry button if it still cannot read it. Media now works in both directions: photos, videos and voice notes sent from the web client store the file URL in the message text rather than a separate media field, so those messages used to arrive as an empty tile or a voice note with nothing to play — both are read now. Tapping a video plays it (real playback with pause and seek instead of a still frame), a clip you send carries its own poster frame, and only one voice note plays at a time.
